newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares end week mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares end week mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Shares in Bank Audi rose to $15.87 from $15 at the end of their first week of trade on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday.
Audi, the second Lebanese commercial bank to list on the BSE, offered all its 4,158,000 C shares -- or 30 percent of its total number of shares -- for trading on the market last Monday.

Shares in Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, which began trading at $11.25 on December 30, fell at the end of the week to $12.25 from $12.375 last Friday. BLC shares were steady between Monday and Thursday at $12.375.
Solidere A shares, which hit a record low of $10.25 end of last week, rose to $10.75 while B shares fell to $10.625 from $11.25.

Total weekly turnover in all traded shares on the BSE rose sharply to 541,896 from 189,200 shares. The turnover included 93,300 Audi shares worth $1,458,563 traded in blocs on the BSE. Total value of shares traded on the floor was $4,181,141.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.53 percent on the week to 81.31 and the BLOM stock index fell 0.45 percent to 905.06.
